note: #3349: PIPs measured with ISE but held out of Silinx's bit database until nextpnr's Spartan-6 chip database has them (a PIP Silinx knows lets its placer give a pad a path nextpnr cannot route, #3152). Silinx's flow does not read this file (bitdb.js s6DbNames, bitDbS6 without held); research/nextpnr-s6/export-unknown-pips.mjs does (held: true), so the fork's chip database generator, at a SILINX_REF with this file, includes them. Once the released chip database has them, they move to the files Silinx reads and leave this one. #3269: TIOI_INNER's slave OLOGIC2 D1 -> OQ route-through, measured by #3176's BSCAN designs c3 and c4 (research/s6/measure-3176-s6.sh) on the output q; offsets from gridRegion. #3350: TIOI_OUTER's slave OLOGIC2 D1 -> OQ, the same bits, measured on a LUT's output on C4 and E13 (XC6SLX16), C4 and A13 (XC6SLX45) (research/s6/gen-padout6.mjs, measure-3169-s6.sh): the drop always takes it with TIOB TIOB_O1 -> TIOB_O1_PINW (no bits), the bits that change exactly these. #3169: the *IOB_SINGLE tiles' pad wire -> IBUF PIPs, measured with no bits on both parts (research/s6/gen-padsingle6.mjs, measure-3169-s6.sh: one design per pad of those tiles); TIOB_IBUF0's drop took it with TIOI_OUTER TIOI_OUTER_IBUF0 -> D_ILOGIC_IDATAIN_IODELAY_S, the bits that changed exactly that PIP's known ones.
